name: Taira no Katsuzane
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Seiryu of Earth for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Father, mother, unnamed elder brother, Chitose (younger sister), uncle
Occupation: Noble of the Heike / Kyoushiki Shoujou
Innate Element: Wood
Weapon(s): Bow and arrows (arrows may be fired as darts of energy instead)
Favorite Scent: Baika
Favorite Color: Asagi (bluish-teal)
Favorite Flower(s): Japanese gentian (autumn) / Heavenly bamboo (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
